units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 5:10">Ib. 10</cite> <he>תַּנּוּרוֹ של עכנאי</he>, v. <cite ref="P00744"><he>עַכְנַאי</he></cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 59b:1">B. Mets. 59ᵇ</cite>; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>תַּנּוּרִים</he>, <he>תַּנּוּרִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 5:4">Kel. V, 4</cite> <he>נפלה … בתַנּוּרֵי כפר סגנה</he> a conflagration took place in the oven factory of K’far Signah.
